verified_limits: All compared Lev2 runs used pixel-identical full-page images. V4 crop size is identical; historical crop origin/header identity may differ slightly. Historical Front V2/V3 used standalone Front, Haiku 5.5 low effort, and returned thinking tokens. This comparison cannot isolate stage composition from provider settings or context.

Medium baseline and locate-first used identical messages, crop bytes and metadata. The frame mismatch is already present on exact crops, before reprojection to a full page. The 32 px header cannot explain it.

Pixel interpretation recovers all nine original medium V4 Lev2 faces in the measured groups. In locate-first, V4 lower door group is absent, not merely misplaced, while two V3 lift-up boxes match their actual faces in pixels.
Nine original and five locate-first Lev2 F boxes are out of bounds if all numbers are interpreted as pixels. Pixel conversion cannot be applied globally or inferred reliably from an in-range check.

Lev1 Detection already states three drawers on V4. On the exact 442x643 crop the drawer face spans approximately y=493..531 px; locate-first supplies y=895..965 in bbox_1000, interpreted as y=575..620 px.
